title: Asking for wellbeing
cue: The duas the Prophet ﷺ never left, morning and evening
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-'aakhirah, allaahumma as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fee deenee wadunyaaya wa'ahlee wamaalee, allaahummastur 'awraatee, wa'aamin raw'aatee, wahfaznee mim bayni yadayy, wamin khalfee, wa'an yameenee, wa'an shimaalee, wamin fawqee, wa'a'oodhu bika an ughtaala min tahtee
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in my religion and my worldly life, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears, and guard me from in front of me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me; and I seek refuge with You from being seized unawares from beneath me.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Ibn Majah, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 3871: https://shamela.ws/book/1198/5348

provenance.note: The printed Abd al-Baqi text on Shamela has اللهم أسألك in the second sentence; hadith-api has اللهم إني أسألك. We follow the printed edition.

usage.evidence: Ibn Umar said the Prophet ﷺ never left these duas, evening and morning (Ibn Majah 3871; Abu Dawud 5074 relates it with small differences).
